heroSub: At Groupe Atlantic's plant in Izmir Gaziemir ESBAS Free Zone, products carried on production busbars were tracked by operation up to packaging.
contextP1: Groupe Atlantic manufactures towel warmers at its Izmir facility. In this project, products moving on production busbars were tracked operation by operation.
contextP2: The goal was to maintain full product-busbar visibility up to packaging and improve process control.
problemTitle: Visibility and control gaps in manual tracking
problemLede: At every production stage, it had to be known which products were on which busbar and in which operation they were located.

problemList.text: Manual methods made it hard to maintain a reliable product-busbar relationship across all stages.
Limited stage visibility created process control risks.
A digital structure was needed to ensure uninterrupted traceability up to packaging.

solutionLede: Production busbars were tracked and both product-busbar relationships and operation states were recorded in real time.

steps.title: Code Reading
steps.text: Busbars and products are scanned at operation transitions with field readers.

steps.title: Operation Recording
steps.text: The product-busbar relationship and operation status are updated instantly.

steps.title: SCADA Processing
steps.text: Tracking data is processed through the existing SCADA infrastructure.

steps.title: Tracking to Packaging
steps.text: Busbars and products are monitored continuously until packaging.

techTitle: Code readers, PLC, and OnSuite Trace

techGrid.title: Code Readers
techGrid.text: Field readers scan busbars and products in real time.

techGrid.title: PLC Field Control
techGrid.text: PLC controls field flow and forwards data to the process layer.

techGrid.title: SCADA Integration
techGrid.text: All reads are processed in SCADA for operation-based traceability.

techGrid.title: OnSuite Trace
techGrid.text: Traceability and process management are centralized on OnSuite Trace.

integrationDesc: The solution works integrated with the customer's SCADA and ERP systems. Busbar and product tracking data is processed in SCADA and shared with ERP.

integrationList.text: Busbar and product tracking data is processed through the existing SCADA system.
Traceability and production data are shared with ERP for centralized management.

resultsGrid.title: Operation-Based Traceability
resultsGrid.text: Busbars and products became traceable operation by operation up to packaging.

resultsGrid.title: Product-Busbar Visibility
resultsGrid.text: Product-busbar relationships and operation status became visible at each stage.

resultsGrid.title: Reduced Manual Work
resultsGrid.text: Reduced manual tracking needs strengthened process control and traceability.
